meta.name: google-analytics
meta.description: Analyze connected Google Analytics 4 traffic, acquisition, engagement, landing pages, ecommerce, events, and conversions, and safely manage supported GA4 key events or custom dimensions through NotFair MCP. Use for GA4, Google Analytics, traffic or conversion drops, channel attribution, realtime activity, report requests, measurement configuration, or Analytics MCP setup.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 连接谷歌分析，看流量转化走势，管理统计事件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在用谷歌分析看流量和转化，想通过对话直接获取洞察和配置事件。
copy.tagline_en: Connect Google Analytics to read traffic and conversions and manage events
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you track GA4 traffic and conversions and want to chat about insights and event setup.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会通过 NotFair MCP 读取你已连接的 GA4 数据,生成流量、来源、转化等报告并对比同期;遇到采样或配额限制会提醒。涉及修改关键事件或自定义维度时,它会先说明影响、等批准再改。
howto.when: 当你提到 GA4 或 Google Analytics,或问流量/转化下滑、渠道归因、实时活动等,或要求看报告、改测量配置时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析最近 7 天 GA4 流量,按渠道对比上周。
say.note: Claude 会运行多渠道报告并说明变化。

say.text: GA4 转化下滑了,可能是什么渠道导致的?
say.note: Claude 会对比同期数据,给出基于证据的可能原因。

say.text: 想把某个事件设为 GA4 关键事件,怎么操作?
say.note: Claude 会先展示影响,获批准后再执行。

howto.what_en: Claude reads connected GA4 data via NotFair MCP, runs traffic/acquisition/conversion reports, compares periods, flags sampling/quota warnings. It avoids causality claims without evidence; changes key events/custom dimensions with approval.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention GA4/Google Analytics, or ask about traffic or conversion drops, channel attribution, realtime activity, etc., or request reports or measurement configuration.

say_en.text: Analyze last 7 days of GA4 traffic by channel vs prior week.
say_en.note: Runs a channel report and highlights changes.

say_en.text: GA4 conversions dropped; which channel might be causing it?
say_en.note: Claude compares periods and gives evidence-based likely driver.

say_en.text: How do I make an event a key event in GA4?
say_en.note: Claude shows the impact and asks approval before applying.
